# SiloVaultArk

## SiloVaultArk
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/contracts/arks/SiloVaultArk.sol)

**Inherits:**
[Ark](../ark.md)

**Title:**
SiloVaultArk

Ark contract for managing token supply and yield generation through Silo vaults.

Implements strategy for depositing tokens, withdrawing tokens, and claiming rewards from Silo vaults.


### State Variables
#### silo
The Silo this Ark interacts with


```solidity
ISilo public immutable silo
```


#### incentivesController
The Silo Incentives Controller for claiming rewards


```solidity
ISiloIncentivesController public immutable incentivesController
```


### Functions
#### constructor

Constructor to set up the SiloVaultArk


```solidity
constructor(address _silo, ArkParams memory _params) Ark(_params);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_silo`|`address`|Address of the silo|
|`_params`|`ArkParams`|ArkParams struct containing necessary parameters for Ark initialization|


#### totalAssets

Returns the total assets managed by this Ark in the silo


```solidity
function totalAssets() public view override returns (uint256 assets);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`assets`|`uint256`|The total balance of underlying assets held in the silo for this Ark|


#### _withdrawableTotalAssets

Internal function to get the total assets that are withdrawable

SiloVaultArk is always withdrawable up to maxWithdraw


```solidity
function _withdrawableTotalAssets() internal view override returns (uint256 withdrawableAssets);
```

#### _board

Deposits assets into the silo


```solidity
function _board(uint256 amount, bytes calldata) internal override;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of assets to deposit|
|`<none>`|`bytes`||


#### _disembark

Withdraws assets from the silo


```solidity
function _disembark(uint256 amount, bytes calldata) internal override;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of assets to withdraw|
|`<none>`|`bytes`||


#### _harvest

Internal function to harvest rewards using the Silo Incentives Controller

This function will be implemented to handle Silo-specific reward claiming


```solidity
function _harvest(bytes calldata)
    internal
    override
    returns (address[] memory rewardTokens, uint256[] memory rewardAmounts);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`rewardTokens`|`address[]`|Array of reward token addresses|
|`rewardAmounts`|`uint256[]`|Array of claimed reward amounts|
